text:
Rina: quick idea 1: host a 45m webinar with two 12-min lightning demos, one 15-min customer deep-dive, then 6m rapid-fire AMA. goal = tight energy + clear next-step CTA. thoughts?

Tom: love the energy. for the lightning demos can we pick orthogonal themes: 1) sub-50ms tail latency patterns, 2) cost-per-inference optimization. keep slides to 3 per demo.

Eli: agree. customer deep-dive should be a realtime troubleshooting story 1: show a regressed eval, roll back to previous model, and restore SLOs. makes it tangible.

Rina: good call. also want a short "how we measured it" appendix slide for transparency. Priya, can growth own the registration CTA and lead routing?

Priya: yes. plan: short form (email + company + use-case) -> webhook -> HubSpot -> auto-tag: webinar_q2_2026. add a hidden field "bench_interest" if they opt into receiving benchmark notes.

OpsBot: (auto) Reminder: set the webhook retry rules to 3 attempts, backoff 30s.

Tom: on speakers: internal: Enginfra for latency demo, ML infra for cost demo. external: ask @CartaOps for a customer deep-dive (they saw quantization wins). Eli can shadow as backup.

Eli: will coordinate with CartaOps. if they decline, I have an early-stage founder who can speak to cost savings.

Rina: good. rehearsal cadence suggestion: 1) sponsor walkthrough doc, 2) individual recorded runthroughs by Fri, 3) one full dress + AV check 48h before. we need timeboxed fallbacks: at 11:50 host asks "demo green?" if no, flip to pre-record.

Priya: capture fallback media as 2 versions per demo: 60s clip for quick swap and 4m full pre-record. upload to shared drive with naming convention: webinar_2941112222_demo1_60s.mp4 etc.

Tom: social copy roughs (short):
- "Build predictable LLM features: lightning demos + a customer deep-dive. Wed, May 14. Sign up."
- "Tradeoffs, numbers, and rollback recipes for inference at scale."

Rina: Legal note: avoid publishing explicit cost numbers in promo. if we want to publish e.g., "50% cost reduction" we need bench notes + Legal signoff. tagging @LegalBot.

LegalBot: (auto) Please submit benchmark claims with 1) dataset details, 2) model versions, 3) exact config and infra. Use docs/bench-claims-template.md. Approval SLA: 48 hours.

Eli: will prepare bench appendix doc and include raw logs. can we surface the bench appendix as gated content for registrants? that might boost lead quality.

Priya: yes -> add hidden checkbox "send me bench appendix" to form and map to HubSpot property bench_interest. good lead signal.

Tom: tracking/analytics: set UTM for all promo to utm_campaign=lightning-infer_may14, and map source to lead owner via UTMs. Priya to set up.

Rina: run-of-show draft (45m):
- 00:00-02:00 Welcome + goals
- 02:00-14:00 Lightning demo 1 (latency) + 2min q
- 14:00-26:00 Lightning demo 2 (cost) + 2min q
- 26:00-41:00 Customer deep-dive + 4min q
- 41:00-47:00 Rapid-fire AMA + close + CTA

Eli: please add explicit AV checkpoints: 5m before and 2m before each segment. host will have a green / yellow / red checklist.

Priya: lead routing note: after webinar run, HubSpot -> flow -> SDR queue (score>50) or marketing nurture (score<=50). need SDR owner mapping in HubSpot before send.

Tom: demos: set demo env to allow safe "failure mode": throttled token limit, fallback endpoint, and scrubbed data. list the endpoint URLs in the rehearsal doc.

Rina: communications: draft two short social posts + one long-form follow-up blog that includes bench methodology and links to code samples. sponsor to review by +72h post event.

OpsBot: (auto) Rehearsal reminder scheduled: 2941112346 (48h prior).

Eli: volunteer to record the short fallback clips tonight. tagging @Tom to confirm talking points.

Tom: confirmed. I'll post talking points in the shared doc and tag presenters.

Priya: timeline recap: registration live by Mon, promos start Tue, speaker pre-reads to presenters Wed, recorded runthroughs due Fri, full dress Thu.

Rina: perfect. small ask: can marketing own the attendee Qs during AMA (triage), escalate to eng for tech questions with "eng-answer" tag?

Tom: yes. we'll have two slack channels during live: #webinar-ops (internal) and #webinar-live (moderated audience).

Rina: thanks all 60; let's keep updates here.

LegalBot: (auto) Bench claim checklist link: https://redwood.internal/bench-claims-template.md

Priya: uploading form + webhook config now, will share link in thread when done.
